items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-05-28
items.q: And of course on the other side I was hearing Bing Crosby

ctx.x: Any songs come to mind, things that you heard that stood out as a kid?

Well, yes and no. I can't now say this was the most impressive song I ever heard. But you've got to remember in those days I was hearing things like Lil Green, Ma Rainey, Armstrong of course, early Jordan, Louis Jordan. And of course on the other side I was hearing Bing Crosby, I was hearing the country artists, and people like that. And we always had one or two ethnic records on the white side, Irish tune or German tune, or depending on who was a regular customer that played the box a lot and said, why don't you…
You know, that kind of thing. So, we talked about family. Were the Italian holidays very special for your family? Oh, sure. Yeah. I'm talking Columbus Day, St. Joseph's Day.
